mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to a journey that weaves together revolution, exile, and the relentless pursuit of ideals. Imagine stepping into the world of a young mind, awakened in the chaos of late imperial Russia, where injustice runs deep but the dream of radical change flickers on the horizon. Together, we'll trace the remarkable path laid out in My Life: An Attempt at an Autobiography by Leon Trotsky—a thinker and leader whose vision would ripple through the twentieth century. As we move through the rise and fall of empires, the forging of revolutionary movements, and the heavy price of unwavering conviction, you'll get to know Trotsky not just as a historical figure, but as a person—brilliant, uncompromising, and often standing alone, whether among friends or foes. We’ll dive into sweeping moments of history, but also pause for those intimate reflections: family, friendship, betrayal, and the search for meaning when the world feels upside down. What drives someone to keep pushing for transformation, even in the face of triumph and tragedy? What does it really mean to live at the heart of world-shaking events, where personal ambition and historical forces collide? Together, we'll explore all of this—and more. So, as we open the pages of Trotsky’s life, let’s get ready to discover not just the contours of a revolutionary era, but the complexities and contradictions that shape us all.
